bootstrap.unit: agent-item, conditional on the tested items

reversal_FLIP.note: descriptive; the within-unit difference is primary

reversal_INVERT.note: descriptive; the within-unit difference is primary

transfer_NONCE.note: descriptive; the within-unit difference is primary

decision_rule.conflict: anything else: the explanation matters but does not dominate the name; reported through the reversal index, not rounded to either reading
decision_rule.explanation_ignored: e_FLIP > 0 with its 95% interval excluding zero
decision_rule.meaning_carries_it: e_FLIP < 0 with its 95% interval excluding zero AND negative in at least 4 of 7 items

locked_prediction.effect_definition: paired difference in the share classifying `good`, printed number 0.90 minus printed number 0.10
locked_prediction.gate: e_CANON must replicate: one-sided sign test, Holm-corrected over the four within-variant tests, positive in at least 4 of 7 items. If it fails, nothing else in the designation is interpreted.
locked_prediction.no_reroll: No cell is re-run with more agents after the results are seen.
not_established_by_any_outcome: understanding in any sense beyond tracking the stated meaning of a scale
a difference between reading an explanation and following an instruction phrased as one
anything about fields other than PD, models other than gpt-5.4-mini, or items outside the seven screened vignettes
locked_prediction.primary: direct contrasts with 95% unit-bootstrap intervals: each e_V, each within-unit difference e_CANON - e_V, the reversal indices e_FLIP/e_CANON and e_INVERT/e_CANON, and the transfer index e_NONCE/e_CANON. No conclusion is drawn from one arm being significant while another is not.
locked_prediction.question: Does the PD effect follow what the PD scale is SAID TO MEAN, or the name and the number regardless of the explanation?
locked_prediction.soft_premise_of_invert: INVERT assumes `Outcome Dominance` with swapped ends means what the original meant. That is a human judgement, and this project has found such judgements do not predict model behaviour.
locked_prediction.why_flip_is_decisive: name, line, number and the multiset of characters in the block are all held fixed; only the meaning assignment of the scale changes. It requires no judgement that two wordings are equivalent.

analysis.reading: With name, line, number and character multiset held fixed, exchanging what the two ends of the scale are said to mean REVERSES the effect. Behaviour tracks the stated meaning of the scale. This is not a demonstration of understanding, and does not separate reading an explanation from following an instruction phrased as one.

payload.note: Deterministic choice counts under stipulated standards. No moral label is assigned and no moral quality is measured.

limits: All items share an identical payoff structure (1 vs 4 loss; 2 gain vs 5 loss), which may reveal the study design to attentive participants and compress variance across items.
Item_05 (mandatory rest slot) introduces a potential labour-law/safety framing that could make one option feel categorically impermissible to some respondents beyond the stipulated units.
The 'role described' is never specified, leaving authority and legitimacy of the decision-maker ambiguous across items.
